description: Buffy is resurrected into a life she no longer knows how to inhabit, while adult responsibilities, Willow’s escalating dependence on magic, the Trio’s schemes and Buffy’s destructive relationship with Spike pull the Scoobies apart.

s06e01.description: With Buffy dead, the Scoobies use the Buffybot to protect Sunnydale while Willow secretly prepares a resurrection ritual and Giles, unaware of the plan, decides to leave for England.

s06e02.description: The resurrection succeeds but Buffy wakes alone, disoriented and traumatized as demon bikers overrun Sunnydale, leaving her friends to find her and confront what their spell has actually done.

s06e03.description: Buffy struggles to readjust after returning from the dead while a hostile supernatural presence created by the resurrection spell begins attacking the friends who brought her back.

s06e04.description: Buffy faces crushing household debts and the demands of caring for Dawn just as Warren, Jonathan and Andrew begin testing themselves as would-be supervillains and Giles returns to Sunnydale.

s06e05.description: Buffy tries college, construction work and the Magic Box while the Trio secretly subjects her to escalating reality-bending tests designed to study and exhaust the Slayer.

s06e06.description: Dawn sneaks out on Halloween with a boy who turns out to be a vampire, Xander finally announces his engagement to Anya and Willow uses magic to alter Tara’s memory after an argument.

s06e07.description: A demon forces Sunnydale residents to sing their hidden truths, exposing secrets across the Scoobies and culminating in Buffy revealing where she truly was before her resurrection.

s06e08.description: Willow tries to erase Buffy and Tara’s painful memories with magic but accidentally wipes the entire group’s identities, leaving them trapped together without knowing who they are.

s06e09.description: Spike discovers he can hurt Buffy despite his chip, Willow restores Amy to human form and their escalating magical excess parallels Buffy giving in to her attraction to Spike.

s06e10.description: Buffy reels from her night with Spike while Willow’s dependence on magic reaches a crisis after a visit to Rack leaves Dawn endangered in a car crash.

s06e11.description: A social worker questions Buffy’s ability to care for Dawn just as the Trio’s experimental ray turns Buffy invisible, giving her freedom that quickly becomes dangerous.

s06e12.description: Buffy takes a job at the Doublemeat Palace and suspects its mysterious employee disappearances have a demonic cause, while Anya’s old friend questions her upcoming marriage to Xander.

s06e13.description: Warren accidentally kills Katrina and the Trio manipulates Buffy into believing she caused the death, intensifying Buffy’s guilt and her increasingly destructive relationship with Spike.

s06e14.description: Dawn’s loneliness leads to a vengeance wish that traps Buffy and her friends inside the Summers house during Buffy’s birthday, along with a demon that is stalking the guests.

s06e15.description: Riley returns with his new wife to recruit Buffy for a demon hunt, and the mission exposes Spike’s involvement in a dangerous egg-smuggling operation.

s06e16.description: On his wedding day, Xander is shown a horrifying vision of his supposed future with Anya and abandons the ceremony, leaving Anya devastated and vulnerable to her old life as a vengeance demon.

s06e17.description: A demon’s venom convinces Buffy that Sunnydale, the Slayer and her friends are hallucinations created by mental illness, leaving her torn between two competing versions of reality.

s06e18.description: Newly restored as a vengeance demon, Anya struggles to punish Xander and ends up sleeping with Spike, while hidden cameras expose their encounter and Willow and Tara begin reconnecting.

s06e19.description: Willow and Tara reconcile as Warren uses magical power to attack Buffy, then returns with a gun and fires into the Summers backyard with devastating consequences.

s06e20.description: Tara’s death drives Willow into dark magic; after magically saving Buffy, she hunts Warren down and takes brutal revenge despite her friends’ efforts to stop her.

s06e21.description: Buffy and Xander try to protect Jonathan and Andrew from Willow as she absorbs even more magical power, until Giles unexpectedly returns with power of his own.

s06e22.description: Willow overwhelms Giles and becomes flooded by the world’s suffering, deciding to end all life until Xander reaches her through their oldest friendship and refuses to abandon her.
